desc: The Medium "Come and Take It" is a dual action OTF knife with a Cerakoted aluminum alloy handle, top button trigger and is loaded with a high quality D2 steel blade. Featuring a "Come and Take It" laser engraved logo on one side and a "Gonzales Cannon and Black Star" laser engraved logo on the reverse side. Includes a pocket clip, glass breaker for emergencies and a nylon sheath.
